posts.cooked:
Hello All,

I have a question regarding the price list on material request.
When creating a material request, I select a specific pricelist. Even though in the pricelist, there is the item price for that item, it does not pick up the rate. And when saved the price list is changed to the default price list set in buying settings. Is this a normal behaviour?
And what is the purpose of price list in material request?

Kind Regards

posts.name: Ahsan Tareen
posts.cooked:
Hi @Ayesha

The Material Request docytpe works with item prices under price list due to several reasons;

  1. The item requested in MR docytpe rate can help further drive of the purchase either for local purchase or international one.
  2. Budget controls can be applied on MR doctype requires to have a volume that can only be made multiplying qty with rate.
  3. BOMs also throw material request under production plan and is also multi currency supported for which MR has to work with price list.
